name: React Start app
description: A server-rendered TanStack Start app for anything with data: typed server functions with zod, Tailwind CSS, and translations ready for more languages. The demo is removed when your app is built. Deploys to Node, Vercel, Netlify, or Cloudflare.
prompts: A booking app where customers pick a date and time slot
An expense tracker with categories and monthly totals
A feedback board where users post ideas and vote on them
An admin dashboard with stats cards and a searchable table
